effects.name: Bleed
effects.desc: Debuff: Take 0.2% of the target's max HP in <Color=#ed362e>Physical Damage (Derivative)</color> per second, to a maximum of 10% of the highest ATK/hashrate of any Doll in the battle. Duration is 5 seconds, can stack up to 10 times. This is a damaging status.

effects.name: Super Armor
effects.desc: Remove existing control effects, and grant immunity to control effects (except Expulsion, Suppression, and Forced Dash)

effects.name: Silence
effects.desc: Debuff: Interrupts skill release and halts Auto Skill recharge. This is a control effect

effects.name: Stealth
effects.desc: Buff: Cannot be targeted by the enemies.

effects.name: Blind
effects.desc: Debuff: Normal Attacks have an 80% chance of being dodged.

effects.name: Wallbreak
effects.desc: Damage absorption barrier triggers wallbreak effect when it is broken

effects.name: Absorption
effects.desc: Energy Herbs (including Pseudo - Energy Herbs) will be absorbed when a unit steps on them, and the corresponding effects will be triggered.

effects.name: Control
effects.desc: Debuffs that affect the behavior of the target, including but not limited to Stun, Silence, Taunt, Disarm, Knockback, Airborne, etc.

effects.name: Stained Tile
effects.desc: Debuff: Effective on all units within 1 tile around the target, reducing the Normal Attack DEF of enemy units by 10%. Stackable.

effects.name: Expulsion
effects.desc: Debuff: Ignores Super Armor. This effect removes target from the battlefield and immobilizes it, during which the target does not take damage and becomes untargetable. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Stun
effects.desc: Debuff: Immobilizes target, interrupts skill release and halts Auto Skill recharge. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Disarm
effects.desc: Debuff: Interrupts normal attacks and skills and bans target from using them. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Charm
effects.desc: Debuff: Makes target attack ally units instead. Pauses skill release process and Auto Skill recharge. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Confine
effects.desc: Debuff: Target becomes immobilized. Interrupts normal attacks and skills.This is a control effect.

effects.name: Airborne
effects.desc: Debuff: Forcefully send the target into the air and immobilize it, interrupting its normal attacks and skills. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Knockback
effects.desc: Debuff: Interrupt target's action and force it to Dash in a certain direction. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Trojan
effects.desc: Debuff: Attack Speed reduced by 10 points

effects.name: Recursive Shield
effects.desc: Resist Physical Damage Twice

effects.name: Sear
effects.desc: Explodes when stacked to 4 stacks, each stack provides True Damage of 40% Hashrate. Explosion leaves [Burn] marks that can be stacked up to 5 stacks.

effects.name: Taunt
effects.desc: Debuff: Forces the target to attack the taunting unit. Unit cannot release skills during Taunt. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Defense
effects.desc: Increase Physical DEF by 5%, stacks up to 5 times, buff.

effects.name: Interrupt
effects.desc: Stop Current Action

effects.name: Shieldbreak Effect
effects.desc: Debuff: Normal Attack DEF reduced by 10%, up to 2 layers.

effects.name: Shield
effects.desc: Attacks will damage the HP Shield first. Shield value cannot be recovered via healing.

effects.name: Debuff RES
effects.desc: Reduces Debuff Effect Duration

effects.name: Electromagnetic Field
effects.desc: Deals <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] Operand Damage equal to 10% Hashrate</color> every second. Upon accumulating 4 stacks, deals <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] Operand Damage equal to 150% Hashrate</color> and dispels the electric field. Considered a debuff.

effects.name: Sacrament
effects.desc: Debuff: Attack Speed is reduced by 5 points, Move Speed is reduced by 5 points.

effects.name: Communion
effects.desc: Unable to move, temporarily stops skill cooldown and taunts Eucharist. Eucharist teleports next to the target and deals 20% of its Max HP to it while healing for 50% of the damage dealt and removing this status. Debuff

effects.name: Holy Shield
effects.desc: Absorb Damage Once

effects.name: Mask
effects.desc: Damage dealt through the Mask cannot become a critical strike or be dodged, and it is not affected by the Damage Reduction Tiles.

effects.name: Revitalize
effects.desc: Buff: Each stack recovers the target's HP by 10% of its Hashrate every 3 seconds over a total of 6 seconds. Stackable to 5 layers max.

effects.name: Water Damage Effect
effects.desc: Debuff: All DEF reduced by 10 points, up to 5 layers.

effects.name: Swamp
effects.desc: Debuff: Move Speed reduced by 10 points, up to 5 layers.

effects.name: Antibacterial Layer
effects.desc: Grants immunity to Debuff in the minimum duration. After the minimum duration expires, resists one Debuff then disappear.

effects.name: Bloodthirst Sigil
effects.desc: Buff: Normal Attacks are guaranteed to Crit and deal an extra 30% Life Steal. 1 stack of this buff is consumed every time this effect is triggered.

effects.name: Derivative Damage
effects.desc: Damage dealt is affected by Physical & Operand DEF. Cannot act as a trigger condition of Functions and most Skills.

effects.name: Medic Target
effects.desc: Prioritize ally unit with the lowest HP percentage on the battlefield as the Healing target

effects.name: High ATK Target
effects.desc: Prioritize enemy with the highest ATK on the battlefield as the skill target

effects.name: General Target
effects.desc: Prioritize the most recently attacked enemy as the skill target

effects.name: Lam's Target
effects.desc: Prioritize enemy with the highest HP percentage on the battlefield as the skill target

effects.name: Continuous Skill
effects.desc: Skill recharge is suspended during the duration of this skill

effects.name: Carnival
effects.desc: Buff: Cannot be targeted by enemies. Attack Speed +50. Auto Skill recharge is paused in this state.

effects.name: Effect
effects.desc: Including Buff effects and Debuff effects

effects.name: Nursing
effects.desc: Each stack grants 16% damage reduction, stacking up 5 times. Lose one stack of Nursing each time damage is taken, Buff

effects.name: Absorb
effects.desc: Reduce a certain attribute of the target and receive a buff on the corresponding attribute. Unstackable.

effects.name: True DMG
effects.desc: Unaffected by Physical or Operand DEF, this damage doesn't trigger Backlash, Life Steal or other damage-related effects, and won't trigger damage conditions for Functions and Skills. However, it is subject to damage multipliers and Damage Reduction.

effects.name: Elite Target
effects.desc: Prioritize Leader enemies as the skill target

effects.name: Mask Feature
effects.desc: Damage dealt cannot score Critical Hits or be dodged, but it can Crit through Functions or other special means.

effects.name: Vulnerability
effects.desc: Debuff: Damage received increased by 3%, up to 10 stacks

effects.name: Supporter Target
effects.desc: Select Doll with the highest ATK on the battlefield as the skill target

effects.name: Dodge Stance
effects.desc: Evasion increases by 50%, damage received increases by 20%, each evasion increases Auto Skill charge progress by 1 second.

effects.name: Star Sigil
effects.desc: Each stack increases the skill damage of Mara's Twilight Plague. 20 stacks max, cannot be dispelled

effects.name: Titan's Power
effects.desc: Buff: Attack Speed increased by 50 points, Crit Rate increased by 60%

effects.name: Storm Effect
effects.desc: Buff: Attack Speed raised by 40 points

effects.name: Turbulence Effect
effects.desc: Buff: Attack Speed raised by 100 points

effects.name: Drunk effect
effects.desc: Buff: ATK and Hashrate increased by 50%

effects.name: Choco Effect
effects.desc: Buff: Increases DEF by 200 points

effects.name: Silence Compensation
effects.desc: Debuff: Targets that cannot be Silenced will have their Skill Haste decreased by 50%. This effect will not be canceled out by Super Armor.

effects.name: Chill
effects.desc: Reduces Move Speed by 50%. Each stack reduces Attack Speed by 2 points, up to 10 stacks. The Chill effect lasts 5 seconds

effects.name: Performance Boost
effects.desc: Buff: Skill Haste increased by 5%, 10 stacks max.

effects.name: Cripple
effects.desc: Debuff: Target becomes immobilized. ATK and Hashrate decreased by 10%. This is a control effect

effects.name: Immobilize
effects.desc: Debuff: Target becomes immobilized. This is a control effect.

effects.name: Allergy Attack
effects.desc: Deals Operand Damage based on Hashrate to enemies within 7 tiles.

effects.name: Focus
effects.desc: All characters are forced to attack the target in question. Melee units will automatically move into attack range. Once this effect ends, they will find new attack targets.

effects.name: Scorch
effects.desc: Debuff: Each stack deals <Color=#2ba8c4>10% Hashrate of "Derivative" Operand Damage</color> per second, up to 10 stacks

effects.name: Summon
effects.desc: Summoned creatures are only affected by their summoner's stat multipliers. They will not be directly affected by Functions or Protocol effects.

effects.name: Stifle
effects.desc: Debuff: Become immobilized and untargetable. Interrupts and halts skill recharge. This is a control effect that cannot be resisted with Super Armor.

effects.name: Forced Dash
effects.desc: Ignores Super Armor. Forces target to Dash to the surrounding empty tile

effects.name: Direct Damage
effects.desc: Damage dealt by skills or normal attacks and not status effects.

effects.name: Status Damage
effects.desc: Damage dealt by Bleeding, Backlash, terrain tiles and so on.

effects.name: Ragetide
effects.desc: Buff: Hashrate +50%, vanishes after the first time a skill is activated and damages and heals a target. Does not stack, duration of 12 seconds.

effects.name: Nixflame
effects.desc: Debuff: Each stack causes the target to lose HP equal to 10% of the highest Hashrate on the field per second. Stacks up to 10 times, duration of 6 seconds.

effects.name: Stat Conversion
effects.desc: Sueyoi's Crit Rate and extra Crit DMG are converted into charging speed for passive skill. After conversion, he won't have the stats: Every 1% of Crit Rate becomes 0.8% of charge speed while every 1% of extra Crit DMG becomes 0.4% of charge speed.

effects.name: Unable To Crit
effects.desc: This damage cannot be made to Crit by Normal Attacks, but by Function Cards and other special methods.

effects.name: Guidance
effects.desc: Unable to perform normal attacks while Guidance is in effect. Guidance is interrupted by control effects, movement, losing one's target or by the use of an Ultimate Skill.

effects.name: Wit's End
effects.desc: Dodge Rate +50%, unable to act, interrupts skill usage and prevents charging of Auto Skill. Can use Ultimate Skill but cannot be resisted by Super Armor.

effects.name: Mindsurge
effects.desc: ATK +150%, then decreases by 50% every 10 seconds thereafter. Once the bonus vanishes, enter permanent "Wit's End" state.

effects.name: Crippling Injury
effects.desc: Received healing is reduced by 5%, Max 10 stacks (debuff)

effects.name: Nuclear Overflow
effects.desc: Deals <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] Operand Damage equal to 30% Hashrate</color> to the nearest enemy every second for every stack. Lasts for 4 seconds, up to 3 stacks

effects.name: Malfunction
effects.desc: Attack Speed -25%. Debuff

effects.name: Conduction Damage
effects.desc: This damage is not affected by Physical or Operand DEF, does not trigger Backlash, Life Steal or other damage-related effects, does not trigger damage conditions for Function Cards and skills, and it is not affected by damage multipliers or damage reduction.

effects.name: Absolute Damage
effects.desc: This damage is not affected by Physical or Operand DEF, does not trigger Backlash, Life Steal or other damage-related effects, does not trigger damage conditions for Function Cards and skills, and it is not affected by damage multipliers or damage reduction.

effects.name: Lethargy
effects.desc: Debuff, ATK and Hashrate -20%, does not stack.

effects.name: Winged Onrush
effects.desc: Deal <Color=#2ba8c4>Operand Damage equal to 400% Hashrate</color>. 10 second cooldown

effects.name: Primordial Calling
effects.desc: When the [Fossil Dragon] deals damage with Normal Attacks or [Winged Onrush], deal <Color=#2ba8c4>Operand Damage equal to 45% Hashrate</color> in a 1 tile radius around the target.

effects.name: Bind
effects.desc: Cannot act, interrupts Skill usage, Control effect, debuff

effects.name: Drum Aide
effects.desc: Summoned creature that inherits 75% of Undine's ATK and Hashrate, 100% of her Physical and Operand DEF and 60% of her Max HP. Melee attacker (Warrior) whose Normal Attacks deal 50% of her Hashrate as Operand damage to all enemies within a 1 tile radius.

effects.name: Brass Aide
effects.desc: Summoned creature that inherits 75% of Undine's ATK and Hashrate, 50% of her Physical and Operand DEF and 40% of her Max HP. Ranged attacker (Sniper) whose Normal Attacks fire piercing shots that deal 50% Hashrate as Operand Damage. If the target has less than 50% HP, she deals 75% Hashrate as Operand Damage instead.

effects.name: Carnage Seal
effects.desc: Increases damage taken, stacks up to 10 times, Debuff

effects.name: Enhancement Sigil
effects.desc: Increases Physical and Operand DEF, stacks up to 10 times, Buff

effects.name: Giant
effects.desc: Increase ATK and Hashrate by 20%, gain an enlarged body, stacks up to 5 times, buff.

effects.name: Protection of Dawn
effects.desc: Deals 15% extra damage to Entropized monsters; suffers 15% less damage from Sanctifiers.

effects.name: Daybreak's Clarity
effects.desc: When doing damage with an <Color=#FA8072>Innate Skill</color>, damage is based on the higher between ATK or Hashrate, while damage type will be whichever type does more damage (calculation includes the appropriate DEF type, vulnerability, PEN, etc.)

effects.name: Chill
effects.desc: Move speed reduced by 50%, Attack Speed reduced by 2% per stack, stacking up to 10 times.

effects.name: Nixflame
effects.desc: Lose 10% of friendly Hashrate per stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times, debuff.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.desc: Take <Color=#2ba8c4>40% of ally Doll Hashrate in Operand Damage</color> per second for 2 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

effects.name: Innate Skill
effects.desc: A skill naturally possessed by the character. Does not include skills or abilities granted by Functions, Algorithms, Protocols, etc.

effects.name: Electromagnetic Field
effects.desc: Deals <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] Operand Damage equal to 10% Hashrate</color> every second. Upon accumulating 4 stacks, deals <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] Operand Damage equal to 150% Hashrate</color> and dispels the electric field. Considered a debuff.

effects.name: Missile
effects.desc: Projectile

effects.name: Meteor
effects.desc: Projectile

effects.name: Ethereal Spear
effects.desc: Projectile

effects.name: Fox Buggy
effects.desc: Summoned Creature. Inherits 50% of Taisch's Physical and Operand DEF and 35% of her HP.

effects.name: Iceburst
effects.desc: For every stack of <Color=#ed372e>Chilled</color> on the target, inflict <Color=#2ba8c4>30% of Hashrate in [Derivative] Operand Damage</color> to the target and all enemies within one tile. Each stack of Chilled on the target increases the damage multiplier by 2%.

effects.name: Rune of Anamnesis
effects.desc: Reduce the target's DEF by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. If a unit with [Rune of Anamnesis] on it dies, half of the stacks will be transferred to the enemy unit that currently has the lowest HP.

effects.name: Iceburst
effects.desc: Once <Color=#ed372e>Chilled</color> stacks reach 10, clear them after 1 second and deal 500% of the character's Hashrate as <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] Operand Damage</color>.

effects.name: Pyrolysis
effects.desc: Deals 10% of the caster's Hashrate as <Color=#2ba8c4>Pyrolysis Damage</color> [Derivative] [Status Damage] each second for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. Debuff. Not affected by Effect Resist.

effects.name: Pyrolysis Damage
effects.desc: Special damage type. Can be increased or decreased

effects.name: Feebleflame
effects.desc: For every stack present, deal <Color=#2ba8c4>[Derivative] [Status Damage] Pyrolysis Damage</color> equal to 5% of the applier's Hashrate every second for 8 seconds, max 5 stacks

effects.name: Electroshock Zone
effects.desc: Every 1 second, dispel 1 stack of a random buff of an enemy unit standing on this tile for 5 seconds. If the target has the <Color=#ed372e>Pyrolysis</color> active on them, it spreads to all enemy units in a 1 tile radius, applying 1 stack of <Color=#ed372e>Pyrolysis</color> to them. If this tile is overwritten, apply 3 stacks of <Color=#ed372e>Pyrolysis</color> to all units within a 1-tile radius.

effects.name: Zero-G
effects.desc: Forcibly makes target airborne. Target cannot be selected and cannot act. Interrupts Normal Attacks and Skills. Control effect, cannot be applied to units with Super Armor. Lasts for 2 seconds

effects.name: Gash
effects.desc: Every time it is applied, deal <Color=#ed362e>3% * stacks of [Wound] * target's Max HP in Absolute Damage</color> to the target. This damage is increased by 50% when dealt to summons. Also decrease target's ATK, Hashrate and healing received by 4%. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and can stack up to 10 times.

effects.name: Gash
effects.desc: Cannot be cleansed. Every time it is applied, deal <Color=#ed362e>3% * stacks of [Wound] * target's Max HP in Absolute Damage</color> to the target. This damage is increased by 50% when dealt to summons. Also decrease target's ATK, Hashrate and healing received by 5%. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and can stack up to 10 times.

effects.name: Levitation
effects.desc: Forcibly makes target airborne. Target cannot act. Interrupts Normal Attacks and Skills. Control effect, cannot be applied to units with Super Armor. Lasts for 2 seconds

effects.name: Sacrifice
effects.desc: Effects from Dolls that kill allies ignore invulnerability and antideath

effects.name: Plumed
effects.desc: Unit increases in size. Each stack grants 10% ATK and Hashrate

effects.name: Foe-Giant
effects.desc: Unit increases in size. Each stack grants 20% ATK and Hashrate

effects.name: Bulk Up
effects.desc: Unit becomes large. Each stack adds 10% to Physical and Operand DEF. Stacks up to 5 times.

effects.name: Backup Notion
effects.desc: When making normal attacks, [Backup Notion] stats can be expended to deal extra damage if Dupin has no stacks of [Notion]

effects.name: Dodgeable Skill
effects.desc: The damage dealt by this skill can be evaded by the target, at a probability corresponding to the target's evasion rate. Targets with higher evasion rate have a higher chance of evading the skill damage.

effects.name: Teleport
effects.desc: Dolls which teleport via skills, teleport tiles, the Teleportation tactical skill and other means.

effects.name: Revenge
effects.desc: Each stack of Revenge increases Hashrate and ATK by 15% and decreases damage taken by 10%.

effects.name: LabMem
effects.desc: Characters from the [Steins;Gate] collaboration are all LabMems. Includes Rintarou Okabe, Mayuri Shiina and Kurisu Makise.

effects.name: World Line Shift
effects.desc: <Color=#44b164>Heals</color> the target which triggers a <Color=#44b164>World Line Shift</color> for 5% of the target's Max HP +25% of their ATK.

effects.name: Kurigohan
effects.desc: Projection. Normal attacks bounce 4 times. The first target takes 60% of normal attack damage as Physical Damage while further bounce targets take 20% of Derivative Physical Damage.

effects.name: Projection
effects.desc: Invincible and cannot be selected. Damage is calculated from Kurisu Makise's stats. Projections vanish immediately if the original dies.

effects.name: Doppelganger
effects.desc: Affected by character stats. Is not directly affected by Function or Protocol effects. Has a limited lifespan. Cannot be sacrificed.

effects.name: New Passive
effects.desc: After summoning 2 [Kurigohans], <Color=#ed362e>summons an additional Kurigohan</color> for every 20 points of Eureka gained. A maximum of 5 [Kurigohans] can exist at once.

effects.name: Passive Skill
effects.desc: Normal attacks bounce 4 times. <Color=#ed362e>The first target takes 60% of normal attack damage as Physical Damage that can crit while further bounce targets take 20% of [Derivative] Physical Damage.</color>

effects.name: Auto Skill
effects.desc: Targets the most distant unit and deals penetrating physical damage that can crit. <Color=#ed362e>The base damage is 300% of ATK as physical damage</color>, and every penetrated enemy unit additionally <Color=#ed362e>increases this multiplier by 30%</color>, with a <Color=#ed362e>maximum multiplier increase of 90%</color>. Every unit killed <Color=#ed362e>grants 3 seconds of Auto Skill Charge</color>.

effects.name: Ultimate Skill
effects.desc: Forcibly halts all active movement on the battlefield by all units. Only Kurisu Makise can use normal attacks and Auto Skills. Lasts for 5 seconds. While the Ultimate Skill is in effect, Kurisu Makise's ATK is increased by 30% and her attack speed is increased by 50%.

effects.name: Crystal
effects.desc: Crystals are activated when a friendly Doll enters a tile containing a Crystal. If a Crystal is not activated during its duration, the cooldown for generating the Crystal again is reduced by 20%.

effects.name: Volatile Crystal
effects.desc: When activated, all Dolls gain 50% ATK and Hashrate for 6 seconds.

effects.name: Sheltering Crystal
effects.desc: When activated, all Dolls gain a Shield equal to 20% Max HP, and 30% Dodge Rate for 6 seconds.

effects.name: Blinding Crystal
effects.desc: When activated, deal True Damage equal to 500% of highest allied ATK to all enemies and Blind them for 2 seconds.

effects.name: Impairing Crystal
effects.desc: When activated, apply three stacks of Pyrolysis, Bleed, Chill, Vulnerability and Nixflame to all enemies.

effects.name: Soaring Crystal
effects.desc: When activated, teleport in place and then randomly generate one of the following: Volatile Crystal, Sheltering Crystal, Blinding Crystal or Impairing Crystal.

effects.name: Ascension Crystal
effects.desc: When activated, simultaneously triggers the effects of a Volatile Crystal, Sheltering Crystal, Blinding Crystal, Impairing Crystal and Soaring Crystal.

effects.name: Confusion
effects.desc: Applies Blind to the target for a duration equal to this effect's duration. Dodgeable Skills have a 40% chance to be dodged. Debuff.

effects.name: Damage Redirection
effects.desc: Can redirect Normal and Derivative damage taken by a Doll to self. Cannot redirect direct life loss from Miasma tiles and the like. Regardless of whether the redirected damage is Physical, Operand or True Damage, redirected damage is considered Absolute Damage which can be reduced and absorbed by shields.

effects.name: Tremorblast
effects.desc: Enemies with the Tremorblast effect take additional <Color=#2ba8c4>Pyrolysis Damage</color>. Friendly units that attack an enemy unit with the Tremorblast condition on them have a chance to apply an additional stack of Pyrolysis. Lasts 5 seconds.

effects.name: Larceny
effects.desc: Raises a stat and decreases the corresponding stat on the unit that has been affected by Larceny. Lasts for the entire battle.

effects.name: Sacrificial Frame
effects.desc: Neutral unit which can be attacked by both allies and enemies. When summoned, it connects to the enemy unit with the highest HP and becomes immune to death. Death immunity is dispelled when the unit it is connected to dies.

effects.name: Crystal Sentry Gun
effects.desc:
Allied summon. Invincible. When summoned, it swaps position with a random obstacle on the map.
